title: Fix DefaultComputeChildPlane Float Precision to Double
description: Rewrote DefaultComputeChildPlane and all 10 helper functions from System.Numerics float (32-bit) to double[] arrays (64-bit). Replaced Vector3/Quaternion/Matrix4x4 with double[3]/double[4]/double[16]. Added Vec3 and Quat helper functions. Fixed ConnectionPlacementTranslationBasis caller. Build: 0 errors.
